critique.summary: The three screens retain the scenario, illustration and questions in source order, but the dock obscures reading text on a small phone and the question screen exceeds the specified fit target.
issues: At 320px, the fixed navigation dock covers several lines of the scenario. Keep the text reachable without dock occlusion.
The question screen exceeds the viewport by 54px on phone and 87px on desktop with all note disclosures closed. Adjust the layout or split at a complete question boundary.
The scenario screen has no direct links to the illustration or questions; it relies on sequential navigation.
The situation label renders cream rather than the source-supported green. The restored emblem also has a visibly lighter square background against the banner.

A dock-adjacent “Dërgo” remains on the question screen, but its purpose and hooks are not verified. The supplied checks also do not establish preservation of textarea identifiers, answer keys, saved drafts or failure recovery across the split.

Keep the source ellipsis outside the localized span so the runtime does not replace it; render semantic emphasis with the required static upright Poppins.

critique.summary: The six screens retain the visible story, illustration, prompts, explanation and keywords in order. The phone dock and shared design inconsistencies need correction; several activity behaviors remain unverified.
issues: At 320px, the fixed navigation dock visibly covers story text. Keep reading content clear of the dock while allowing necessary vertical scrolling.
The first screen omits the planned ornament spans, and the discussion and explanation screens omit the source question and book pictograms.
The heading emblem stacks above the title even on desktop rather than appearing beside it as planned.
Reader navigation uses Atkinson Hyperlegible rather than the required Poppins family; the measured 26px headings use weight 700 rather than the specified 600.
Only item-1 has reported input and save/reload tests. Persistence, full accessible names and failure recovery for the four disclosed responses are not established by the supplied checks.

pg040_sec001.html.label: Split the source scenario, complete illustration, and five original unscored response fields into the five planned screens. Replace duplicated hidden labels with one associated visible label per field; preserve all item identities. The original save-and-reload probe failed and Dërgo had no verified submission purpose, so optional notes use local draft saving with error and retry feedback rather than an unverified overlay.
The source opening, illustration and five original fields are now in the five prescribed sections, in PDF order.

critique.summary: The candidate restores the source heading and retains all twelve labeled entry fields, but reader controls obscure content and the printed folio is missing.
issues: The floating Dërgo control and reader dock cover fields on desktop and phone; on the small phone they also obscure the prompt. Audit Dërgo’s purpose and keep any retained control after the fields in normal flow.
The source folio 109 is absent. The reader’s 145/169 counter is not a replacement for the printed folio.
Reader controls render in Atkinson Hyperlegible rather than the required Poppins family. The excursion heading also renders at weight 700 instead of the specified 600.
The source’s green activity marker appears cream in the candidate.

The new save controller waits 350 ms before writing and has no navigation flush, so an immediate exit can leave the latest edit unsaved by that controller. Migration of existing answers and persistence-failure recovery are not verified.
The original notebook image is closed in the supplied candidate views, so its expanded appearance and fidelity cannot be independently confirmed.
